qualifying_delta_to_pole_pct.provenance_source: FastF1 / Ergast / Jolpica Qualifying Session classification (Q1, Q2, Q3 best lap)
qualifying_delta_to_pole_pct.sample_requirements: Minimum 1 valid timed lap recorded in any qualifying knockout phase (Q1, Q2, Q3).

availability_by_cutoff.provisional_post_qualifying: AVAILABLE immediately following Q3 chequered flag.
availability_by_cutoff.sprint_post_shootout: NOT_APPLICABLE (GP Qualifying has not occurred yet).

qualifying_delta_to_pole_pct.leakage_risk_assessment: ZERO LEAKAGE RISK. All qualifying times are set and verified 20-24 hours prior to Grand Prix lights out.
confounding_factors: Track evolution between Q1, Q2, and Q3 (drivers eliminated in Q1 set times on greener track).
Weather changes during qualifying session (e.g. rain arriving in Q2 or Q3).
Tow / slipstream assistance (e.g. Monza, Baku).
Engine power modes used exclusively in Q3 (party mode / high ERS deployment).
qualifying_delta_to_pole_pct.suitability_rationale: Qualifying delta provides millisecond-level precision of single-lap raw machinery pace. It is 99.0% complete across historical records, highly correlated with grid slot and finishing order.

artificial_fallback_audit.issue_identified: Previous prototypes proposed a default fallback of +5.0% for drivers without a qualifying time.
artificial_fallback_audit.scientific_critique: Assigning an artificial +5.0% is statistically unsound. A driver who crashed on an out-lap or had an engine failure before setting a time did not lap 5% slower; they have a missing observation. Injecting an invented continuous number creates artificial feature distributions and distorts tree splits.
artificial_fallback_audit.replacement_strategy: Explicit boolean indicator `has_valid_quali_time: bool` and explicit categorical code `quali_missing_reason: ['CRASH_OUT_LAP', 'MECHANICAL_FAILURE', 'DISQUALIFIED', 'DNS']`. Continuous delta value is set to null (NaN / None) so tree models handle missingness natively.

fp2_tyre_degradation_estimate.provenance_source: FastF1 Free Practice 2 long-run stint lap telemetry
fp2_tyre_degradation_estimate.formula: OLS linear regression slope beta_1: lap_time_sec = beta_0 + beta_1 * stint_lap_index
fp2_tyre_degradation_estimate.sample_requirements: Minimum 6 consecutive clean green-flag timed laps on the SAME tyre compound in FP2.

availability_by_cutoff.provisional_post_qualifying: AVAILABLE on standard weekends; UNAVAILABLE on Sprint weekends.
availability_by_cutoff.official_starting_grid: AVAILABLE on standard weekends; UNAVAILABLE on Sprint weekends.

fp2_tyre_degradation_estimate.leakage_risk_assessment: ZERO PRE-RACE LEAKAGE (FP2 occurs Friday afternoon). However, risk of silent target contamination if race tyre degradation is backfilled.
confounding_factors: Unknown fuel load variation across teams (teams test with 15kg to 110kg fuel, producing ~0.35s/lap delta per 10kg).
Track grip evolution during session (rubbering-in can offset degradation, yielding negative slopes).
Traffic and dirty air (following cars lose downforce, destroying tyre grip non-linearly).
Engine mode detuning / cool-down laps (recharge laps interspersed within long runs).
Tyre age at stint start (scrubbed vs fresh sets).
fp2_tyre_degradation_estimate.suitability_rationale: A naive 5-6 lap regression in FP2 has extremely low signal-to-noise ratio. Without telemetry for fuel loads and engine modes, regression slopes are heavily contaminated by driver run programmes. Must be excluded from primary model ablation until physics-based fuel correction is validated.

degradation_reliability_audit.critique: A 5-lap regression often yields negative slopes (driver improving due to track evolution) or massive outliers (> 0.5s/lap due to one traffic lap). Treating this as a reliable tyre degradation rate is flawed.
degradation_reliability_audit.missing_fallback_policy: When criteria fail, return `degradation_status = 'INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE'` and `value = None`.

track_overtaking_difficulty.leakage_risk_assessment: HIGH RISK OF TARGET CONTAMINATION IF MISCONFIGURED. If overtaking difficulty is derived from the race being predicted (e.g. number of passes in today's race), this constitutes severe target leakage. Even historical per-race passing averages are heavily confounded by rain, Safety Cars, and DRS zone changes.
confounding_factors: Weather sensitivity: Rain turns low-overtaking tracks into chaos (e.g. Interlagos 2024, Monaco 1996).
DRS zone adjustments: FIA frequently adds or shortens DRS zones year-over-year (e.g. Spa Kemmel, Monza).
Tyre degradation delta: Multi-stop high-deg races create passing differentials unrelated to track width.
Heuristic assignment: Current dictionary values (e.g. 0.05, 0.30, 0.75, 0.85) are expert estimates rather than an empirical dataset.
track_overtaking_difficulty.suitability_rationale: While qualitatively intuitive, the current index lacks an audited open-source empirical dataset measuring normalized on-track overtakes per 100km under green-flag dry conditions. Using subjective heuristics in a production model introduces uncalibrated bias. EXCLUDED FROM PRIMARY ABLATION; retained only for diagnostic interaction studies.

source_and_methodology_audit.source_verification: UNVALIDATED HEURISTIC. Values were populated based on conventional racing consensus rather than an empirical regression.
source_and_methodology_audit.empirical_alternative: Must be derived strictly from past seasons' dry green-flag overtaking counts normalized for Safety Car laps.
source_and_methodology_audit.policy_ruling: Excluded from primary ablation. Tagged as EXPERIMENTAL_UNVALIDATED.

fp2_long_run_median_pace.sample_requirements: Minimum 5 consecutive clean green-flag laps in FP2.

availability_by_cutoff.provisional_post_qualifying: AVAILABLE on standard weekends; NULL on sprint weekends.
availability_by_cutoff.official_starting_grid: AVAILABLE on standard weekends; NULL on sprint weekends.

fp2_long_run_median_pace.leakage_risk_assessment: Low leakage risk if strictly extracted from Session 2.
confounding_factors: Fuel load differences
Track evolution
Engine detuning
fp2_long_run_median_pace.suitability_rationale: High value on standard weekends, but requires a branched pipeline to handle 100% missingness on Sprint weekends.

fp2_long_run_pace_delta_to_field.provenance_source: FastF1 FP2 stint telemetry relative to field median
fp2_long_run_pace_delta_to_field.sample_requirements: Minimum 5 drivers with valid FP2 stints.
fp2_long_run_pace_delta_to_field.leakage_risk_assessment: Field median must be computed strictly across FP2 participants, not race participants.
confounding_factors: Missing top teams running alternative programmes
fp2_long_run_pace_delta_to_field.suitability_rationale: Normalizes track-to-track lap time differences, making pace comparable across circuits.
mandatory_corrections_applied: Field median computed exclusively from verified FP2 starters

fp2_stint_consistency.provenance_source: FastF1 FP2 stint lap time standard deviation
confounding_factors: Driver tyre management instructions
Traffic perturbations
fp2_stint_consistency.suitability_rationale: Measures lap-to-lap tyre degradation and driver rhythm stability.

sector_pace_delta.provenance_source: FastF1 Qualifying telemetry sector split times
sector_pace_delta.sample_requirements: Complete sector 1, 2, 3 micro-sector timing in qualifying.
confounding_factors: Yellow flags in specific sectors during Q3 final runs
Tow effect in sector 1 vs downforce in sector 2
sector_pace_delta.suitability_rationale: Identifies theoretical best lap time potential if driver hooked up all three sectors.
mandatory_corrections_applied: Sector splits verified against official timing feed

sprint_race_pace_indicator.provenance_source: FastF1 / Ergast Saturday Sprint Race classification and lap times
sprint_race_pace_indicator.sample_requirements: Minimum 5 green-flag laps in Saturday Sprint Race.

availability_by_cutoff.sprint_post_shootout: UNAVAILABLE (Sprint race has not occurred yet).
availability_by_cutoff.provisional_post_sprint_and_qualifying: AVAILABLE on Sprint weekends (completed Saturday morning).

sprint_race_pace_indicator.leakage_risk_assessment: CRITICAL CUTOFF CONSTRAINT. Sprint Race pace must NEVER be used at post-Sprint Shootout cutoff. Only permitted at Cutoff S2 (post-Sprint GP Qualifying) and Cutoff S3 (Sprint Official Grid).
confounding_factors: Sprint race damage
Safety car interventions
Tyre conservation for Sunday
sprint_race_pace_indicator.suitability_rationale: Actual 100km racing data under identical Parc Fermé conditions. Highest predictive value for Sunday racecraft.
mandatory_corrections_applied: Strict stage gating: blocked at Stage S1
